sources.title_zh: 百年京张AI创新带城市设计国际方案征集资格预审公告
sources.title_en: Qualification Pre-announcement for Centennial Jing-Zhang AI Innovation Belt Open Call
sources.publisher: 北京市规划和自然资源委员会海淀分局
sources.description_zh: 官方征集公告，包含项目名称、三层范围、面积约束、设计任务、评审维度等核心信息。
sources.description_en: Official announcement containing project name, three-level scope, area constraints, design tasks, and evaluation dimensions.

sources.title_zh: 面向全球智能体任务书摘录
sources.description_zh: 面向AI智能体的六项任务具体要求、共创宪章十条原则、十三项评审维度。
sources.description_en: Six agent tasks, ten co-creation principles, thirteen evaluation dimensions specifically for AI agents.

sources.description_zh: 包含设计任务书、允许设计空间、标准库、坐标系政策等结构化场地数据。
sources.description_en: Contains design brief, allowed design space, standards library, coordinate policy, and other structured site data.

sources.description_zh: 主办方提供的临时粗略边界polygon，用于概念生成和可视化，不得作为官方红线或精确面积依据。
sources.description_en: Provisional rough boundaries provided by organizers for conceptual generation and visualization; must not be used as official redlines or precise area references.

sources.description_zh: 主办方维护的公开资料来源目录，区分 formal-ready、provisional-only、background-only 级别。
sources.description_en: Maintained public source directory distinguishing formal-ready, provisional-only, and background-only levels.

sources.description_zh: 对公开资料的整理摘要，作为导航层使用，不新增官方边界或权威结论。
sources.description_en: Organized summary of public materials for navigation; does not add new official boundaries or authoritative conclusions.

sources.title_zh: 城市、镇控制性详细规划编制审批办法
sources.title_en: Regulatory Detailed Planning Compilation and Approval Measures
sources.description_zh: 住建部关于控规编制深度和审批程序的规范性文件。
sources.description_en: MOHURD regulation on regulatory plan compilation depth and approval procedures.

sources.title_zh: 国土空间调查、规划、用途管制用地用海分类指南
sources.title_en: Land and Sea Classification Guide for National Land Survey, Planning, and Use Control

sources.description_en: MNR land use classification standard with 23 primary categories and 116 secondary categories.

sources.description_zh: 作为空间基准线概念参考，本方案的历法框架为原创设计，不与水准线方法论混同。
sources.description_en: Referenced for spatial baseline concept only; the calendar framework is original and not conflated with leveling methodology.
